primary.title: Freelancers need to file ITR by 31 August: Forms, income reporting rules, tax methods and deductions explained
primary.summary: Freelancers must file their ITR by 31 August if they are not required to get their accounts audited. The choice of ITR form, tax method and deductions depends on their income structure. Proper documentation and reconciliation of receipts and foreign income are essential for accurate filing.
